title: Implement published card-template lifecycle and provenance

environment.profile: local acceptance; synthetic fixtures only; GitHub push blocked

evidence: published and retired templates reject in-place editing at domain and HTTP boundaries
editing an immutable version creates a distinct next-version draft and preserves the source snapshot
snapshot round-trip retains format, orientation, objects, fonts, watermark, assets, photo, barcode and signature rules
production jobs optionally retain exact published template identity and BIO-CRD-007 regression remains green
dedicated CredentialService ports and routes connect the approved card-designer surface
three existing canvases remain onChange-only and perform no I/O
commit-bound LIVE Playwright evidence proves the real lifecycle

commands.result: PASS (29/29); direct runner used because sandbox blocks VSTest sockets
PASS in commit-bound builder evidence; local fallback replay was stopped after prolonged scan of generated build outputs

final_acceptance.reason: All five criteria have commit-bound builder evidence, Seyi PASS, focused backend replay, BIO-CRD-007 regression proof, structural/traceability/module gates and a clean host build; no unresolved Critical or High finding exists.
